note: Experiments A and B and the avatar experiment (experiments_ab.md section 2, declared 2026-11-14 before the look check ran). Looks that worker_v4.json does not define; merged with it at Play (worker_v4.json, a B9 file, is not changed). Navigation looks (Sets A and B) are human-like; their names encode person, gender and costume (<person>_<m|f>_<costume>). proposed_split is Nusrat's PROPOSAL for Anisha's data_splits.json, never read as a split: Unity reads the split from data_splits.json only. Third-party and character assets are git-ignored (licences: never committed); asset paths are where the import puts them.

recolour.why: Task 2026-11-14: if cartoon_boxo_01 imports without colours, recolour it from its material names: teal body, orange vest, white hat, dark gloves, navy trousers, brown boots. A material is recoloured only when it is colourless (no base texture, base colour saturation <= colourless_saturation_max); the first rule whose keyword is in the material's name (lower case) wins; a colourless material no rule matches is reported, not guessed. The new URP Lit materials are written next to the imported FBX (git-ignored).
